newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: S&P officials to visit Venezuela Feb 3.
newsitem.headline: S&P officials to visit Venezuela Feb 3.

text.p: Officials from rating agency Standard & Poors Corp will visit Venezuela Monday to evaluate the country's economic and political situation, Finance ministry sources said.
Standard & Poors will meet over four days with officials from the finance ministry, state-owned oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PdVSA) and national state deposits guarantee fund Fogade.

On Friday, S&P upped Venezuela's sovereign outlook to "positive" from "stable," citing "the initial stabilization of the Venezuela's economy and heightened prospects for implementation of structural reforms." About $1.8 billion in rated bonds were affected.
